source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: 'W. J. Watt' among those present at the Limavady Guardians on 22 September 1930 and in November 1930 (Derry Journal, 24 September and 26 November 1930); returned again for Keady in 1933 ('(old)').

note: Triennial election of Limavady rural district (23 divisions). Ten nominations were received, none contested; in the other divisions there were no nominations and the retiring members were deemed re-elected, unnamed in the report (Belfast News-Letter, 2 May 1930, p. 11). No division in Co. Londonderry was contested in 1930 (county council: Webb withdrew in Liberties), so there was no poll; the round stays filed on 1930-06-05, a provisional date not confirmed by any paper read. Five retained members recorded from reports of the new council's meetings (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). No nomination: 'where no nominations have been received the retiring councillors will be deemed to have been re-elected' (Derry Journal, 2 May 1930, p. 12). Division inferred from the 27 May 1927 return (William J. Watt, Belfast News-Letter, 22 April 1927, p. 12); the reports of the new council's meetings name him as a member, and the 1933 list names him as the outgoing member of the same division. No co-option or by-election in this division was found in 1930-33 (the co-options of July 1930 filled other divisions). Deemed re-elected (no nomination).
